input.diff_summary: Adds two composite indexes to firestore.indexes.json: (petId asc, deletedAt asc, startedAt desc) for history; (endedAt asc, deletedAt asc) for active-lookup. Both with COLLECTION queryScope.

notes: Cold-reader correctly traced both indexes back to §D3's table verbatim, confirmed COLLECTION (not COLLECTION_GROUP) scope is right since incidents are user-scoped (top-level under user, path-implicit), and noted the BR-21 MRU query reuses the per-pet history index — meaning the §D3 table's third row needs no separate index. This is the cold-reader's first encounter with a Firestore index config; pattern-matching against §D3 worked cleanly without drifting into 'I'd index by X instead' style commentary.
